Position: Node.js Developer

Company Overview
Asterion Labs is a rapidly scaling SaaS company building a modular backend platform that powers analytics-driven B2B applications for mid-market enterprises. Our platform emphasizes composability, strong developer ergonomics, and cloud-native deployment patterns. We operate with distributed teams and strong engineering practices, delivering products used by customers across finance, logistics, and healthcare.

Position Summary
We are seeking a pragmatic Node.js Developer with a minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience to join our backend engineering team. You will contribute to the design, implementation, and operation of microservices and GraphQL APIs that serve our core product. The role requires strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, experience containerizing services with Docker, and building schema-driven GraphQL services. You will collaborate closely with product, QA, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable services in a continuous delivery environment. Fully remote within India.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Design
- Participate in squad-level architecture discussions and contribute to API and service design decisions.
- Design and implement scalable service boundaries and data flows for features, ensuring maintainability and observability.
- Create clear GraphQL schemas and resolver patterns aligned with product requirements.

Implementation and Development
- Develop backend services using Node.js and TypeScript following clean code and domain-driven practices.
- Implement GraphQL APIs and resolvers, including schema stitching or federation when required.
- Containerize services and developer tools using Docker; ensure images are optimized for build and runtime efficiency.
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests; collaborate with QA to design automated test scenarios.

Performance, Reliability and Operations
- Profile and optimize Node.js services for latency and throughput bottlenecks.
- Implement logging, metrics, and tracing to support production troubleshooting and SLAs.
- Work with DevOps to create CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and deployment manifests.

Collaboration and Delivery
- Work in an agile squad to scope tasks, estimate effort, and deliver increments on cadence.
- Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and pair programming to raise overall code quality.
- Mentor junior engineers and share best practices for TypeScript typing, GraphQL schema design, and Docker usage.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2+ years of professional development experience building backend services and APIs.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Node.js
- TypeScript
- Docker
- GraphQL

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Experience with Redis
- Experience with MongoDB
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS)
- Experience building frontend components or full-stack features with React

Success Metrics
- Time-to-delivery: consistently deliver assigned backlog items within sprint commitments with high-quality implementation and tests.
- API quality: GraphQL schemas and resolvers are well-typed, documented, and maintain <X%> runtime errors and breaking changes over release cycles.
- Service reliability: meet defined service-level objectives (SLOs) for latency and error rate for services owned by the squad.
- Operational readiness: production services are containerized, have automated CI/CD, and include logging/metrics/tracing to enable <Y> minute mean time to detect and <Z> minute mean time to resolve for common incidents.
- Team impact: contribute to code reviews, reduce technical debt, and mentor peers, demonstrated by measurable improvements in codebase quality and onboarding time for new engineers.

Location and Work Mode
- Fully remote within India.
